top_signals.title: BlackRock's Rieder Sees 'Productivity Revolution' in US
top_signals.summary: Rick Rieder, CIO of global fixed income at BlackRock, calls the July US employment report "unremarkable." Speaking on "Bloomberg The Open," Rieder says he expects 6% nominal GDP amid a "productivity revolution" in the US. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Government urged to refuse £1bn British Steel repayment to Chinese former owner
top_signals.summary: Business secretary Jonathan Reynolds has been urged to refuse to pay back almost £1bn in loans to the Chinese former owners of British Steel after it was nationalised earlier this year.  British Steel owed just under £1bn to companies connected to its owner Jingye Steel before it was taken into public ownership in an emergency [...]
